each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

If I draw diagonals from markers outward, the rays from the source have to be considered, especially with the direction. I noticed that if the source is in a certain position, like row 0 facing NE, conflicts arise when it hits the boundary. I'm trying to figure out if the colors are cycling and how to represent rays that start from the corners and move diagonally outward.

I need to analyze how rays from colored markers in a grid might work. Observing the center block, I've noted that lines originate from these markers and extend diagonally.
